title: What Scripture Actually Means by Guard Your Heart
caption:
Scripture says guard your heart. It never said guard your feelings.

It meant guard what you let in. These days, that's your thumb.

Above all else, guard your heart, for everything you do flows from it (Proverbs 4:23). The heart in Proverbs isn't just emotion. It's your whole self, attention and desire included. What gets past your guard becomes what runs you.

Every scroll is a gate you left open. Name the specific hour, the specific app, the specific weakness. Then let the right things in first.
